clue.text: Fashionable place to hold a pop broadcast, though it's re ally not suitable

indicators.note: the words for fashionable and place wrap round, holding, the other pieces

parts.note: in means fashionable, as in 'the in thing'
a site is a place

indicators.note: broadcast means scattered about, so the letters of pop are rearranged

explanation.surface: A trendy venue hosting a pop broadcast turns out to be quite the wrong setting.
explanation.walkthrough: 'broadcast' turns POP into PPO; A plus PPO goes inside IN + SITE. The printed 're ally' is 'really', split by the scan, and serves only as padding before the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Something inapt or out of place for its context is unsuitable.

clue.text: Born dunderhead's requirement

parts.note: née, used before a maiden name, means born
the head, or first letter, of 'dunder' is D

explanation.surface: Being born a fool is a burden someone must live with.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue word 'dunderhead' splits as 'dunder' with its 'head', the first letter D.
explanation.definitionFit: A necessity or something wanted is a requirement.

clue.text: Asked questions, being in favour of retiring

parts.note: pro means for, in favour of
retiring for the night means going to bed

explanation.surface: Someone was quizzed for supporting retirement.
explanation.definitionFit: To probe is to investigate by questioning closely.

clue.text: Senior lord set wrong

indicators.note: set wrong suggests the letters have been put together incorrectly and must be rearranged

explanation.surface: An elderly peer has been badly placed.
explanation.definitionFit: An old person, a senior citizen, is informally called by this word.

clue.text: Some feel despair and gloom over this country

indicators.note: some of the words is used, so the answer lies inside the run despair and

explanation.surface: A nation where some feel hopeless and gloomy.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters run through 'despaIR ANd'; 'feel', 'gloom' and 'over' are padding.
explanation.definitionFit: A Middle Eastern nation, formerly Persia.

clue.text: " in Gaza, at the mill with slaves" (Milton's Samson Agonistes)

definitions.text: " in Gaza, at the mill with slaves" (Milton's Samson Agonistes)

parts.words: " in Gaza, at the mill with slaves" (Milton's Samson Agonistes)
parts.note: a quotation with its first word missing: Milton's blinded Samson, labouring in Gaza, is described as sightless

explanation.surface: A line from Milton about the captive Samson, with one word left blank.
explanation.walkthrough: A fill-in-the-blank: Samson was blinded by the Philistines, so the missing word means without sight.
explanation.definitionFit: Samson had his sight taken by his captors, leaving him blind.

clue.text: A fellow turning up after one-late for work

parts.note: a fellow is a man
I is the Roman numeral one

indicators.note: turning means the word up is read the other way round

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A man showing up behind schedule at one o'clock for his job.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turning' flips UP to PU, which comes after I (one); 'after' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: To work something, such as a puppet or controls, is to handle it skilfully.

clue.text: Admitting occupying medical orderly

indicators.note: occupying means the first piece sits inside the word medical

parts.note: taken as written
tho, short for though, means admitting that

explanation.surface: Confessing to filling the role of a hospital attendant.
explanation.walkthrough: THO is the informal spelling of 'though', in the sense 'admitting that'; it goes inside MEDICAL after ME. 'Orderly' looks like the hospital porter but is the adjective.
explanation.definitionFit: Methodical means systematic and tidy, as an orderly person is.

clue.text: Paper boy!

explanation.surface: A newspaper seller shouting for his errand lad.
explanation.definitionFit: A leaf of a book is one sense; a young attendant, as at a wedding or hotel, is the other.

clue.text: Poor will get back tax

parts.note: to second a motion is to back it
a rate is a local tax

explanation.surface: Someone poor will be refunded some tax.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' looks like 'returned' but is the verb meaning support.
explanation.definitionFit: Inferior, mediocre quality is poor quality.

clue.text: Liberal having to beat about half-a dozen

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the word for beat goes round the other piece

parts.note: to lash is to beat with a whip
VI is six in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: A Liberal politician thrashing around six people.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Liberal' looks like the party but means generous.
explanation.definitionFit: Generous, giving freely, is liberal.

clue.text: He doesn't take chances backing horses!

definitions.text: He doesn't take chances backing horses!

parts.words: He doesn't take chances backing horses!
parts.note: backing horses suggests betting, but here it means fitting the seats that go on horses' backs, a sure trade

explanation.surface: A cautious man who refuses to gamble on the races.
explanation.definitionFit: A craftsman who makes the leather seats riders put on horses.

clue.text: Maybe tied steers together-but that's the way

indicators.note: maybe signals the letters could be arranged in another possible order

explanation.surface: A cowboy tying his steers together in a lane.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Maybe' is the anagram signal for TIED STEERS; 'together-but that's the' is padding.
explanation.definitionFit: A minor road off a main one is a way through town.

clue.text: The valley in economic decline

explanation.surface: A valley hit by an economic slump.
explanation.definitionFit: A hollow in the ground is one sense; a long economic slump, like the 1930s, is the other.

clue.text: Give up and watch when upset

indicators.note: in a down clue, upset means turned over, so the word for watch reads from bottom to top

parts.note: a timer is a device used to watch time

explanation.surface: Surrender and keep an eye on things when you're upset.
explanation.definitionFit: To remit a debt or penalty is to cancel it or let it go.

clue.text: Making use of a stud-no surprise

indicators.note: making use of the letters means working them into something new

explanation.surface: Breeding with a stud horse is nothing unexpected.
explanation.definitionFit: To astonish someone is to surprise them greatly.

clue.text: The cabinet maker's boring contrivance

parts.note: boring looks like dull, but means drilling holes: a carpenter's drilling tool

explanation.surface: A dull invention by a furniture maker.
explanation.definitionFit: A tool with a helical bit used to drill holes in wood.

clue.text: Problem concerning public transport

parts.note: re means concerning, about
a bus is public transport

explanation.surface: A complaint about the buses.
explanation.definitionFit: A picture puzzle of letters and images is a kind of problem to solve.

clue.text: The fall guy appears right about coppers

indicators.note: about means the word for right goes round the other piece

parts.note: due means owed by right, as in 'his due'
coppers are small coins, pence, abbreviated P

explanation.surface: The scapegoat seems justified in his complaint about police.
explanation.walkthrough: 'coppers' looks like police but means copper coins, pence.
explanation.definitionFit: A fall guy is someone tricked or used, a gullible victim.

clue.text: Mineral available in most Continental cafes

indicators.note: available in means the answer can be found inside the words that follow

explanation.surface: A powder sold in most cafes across Europe.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters sit in 'continenTAL Cafes'; 'most' is padding.
explanation.definitionFit: A soft magnesium silicate mineral used in powders.

clue.text: A dog snapping with little hesitation

parts.note: a bit means a little
er is a sound of hesitation

explanation.surface: A dog barks and snaps with hardly a pause.
explanation.definitionFit: A snapping dog is one that bites.

clue.text: Fine adjustment in speculation or asset

indicators.note: in means the rearranged letters go inside the word for speculation

parts.note: a bet is a speculation

indicators.note: adjustment means the letters of fine are altered in order

explanation.surface: Fine-tuning a speculative investment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'adjustment' turns FINE into NEFI, which goes 'in' BET between E and T.
explanation.definitionFit: Something of advantage or value, like an asset, is a benefit.

clue.text: The story-teller's doubly right about cheer

indicators.note: about means the letters for right go round the other piece
doubly means the abbreviation for right appears twice

parts.note: to elate is to cheer

explanation.surface: A storyteller doubly correct about joy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'doubly' gives R twice; one R on each side of ELATE, as 'about' says.
explanation.definitionFit: One who relates, that is narrates, a tale is a narrator.

clue.text: Prepared to imbibe simple non-alcoholic drink

indicators.note: to imbibe means to take in, so the word for prepared contains the other piece

parts.note: set means ready, prepared
a simple is an old word for a medicinal plant

explanation.surface: Ready to drink something simple and alcohol-free.
explanation.walkthrough: A 'simple' is an old name for a medicinal herb; 'simple' reads as plain.
explanation.definitionFit: A sweet fizzy powder or soft drink without alcohol.

clue.text: Arrange the letters again and note the time

parts.note: re is the second note of the sol-fa scale
a spell is a period of time

explanation.surface: Reorder the letters and record the hour.
explanation.definitionFit: To spell a word anew is to write it with different letters.

clue.text: Instruct a 9 to turn back the bed

indicators.note: to turn back means all the pieces read from bottom to top

parts.note: to tell someone is to instruct them
the answer to 9 across is the leaf of a book, abbreviated P

explanation.surface: Ordering a pageboy to turn down the bed.
explanation.walkthrough: '9' refers to 9 across, abbreviated P. 'to turn back' turns the whole run TELL + A + P into the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A straw mattress or crude bed is one sense of this word.

clue.text: Secure the proceeds of salvage

indicators.note: the proceeds of suggests what the word produces when its letters are worked over

explanation.surface: Lock away the money raised by salvage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'proceeds' looks like money raised but signals rearranging SECURE.
explanation.definitionFit: To salvage something is to save it from loss.

clue.text: There are other ranks-a number, it's said

parts.note: OR is the abbreviation for other ranks, non-commissioned soldiers
L is fifty in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: Soldiers below officer level form a group, apparently.
explanation.definitionFit: Spoken rather than written is what an exam marked 'said' describes.

clue.text: Operating solo? Capital!

indicators.note: operating means working, so the letters of solo are worked into a new order

explanation.surface: Flying alone is excellent!
explanation.walkthrough: 'Capital!' looks like an exclamation of approval but is the definition: a capital city.
explanation.definitionFit: The Norwegian capital city.

clue.text: Tops for five-year-old

explanation.surface: The best is for the infants.
explanation.definitionFit: Excellent, the best is one sense; a pupil in the first year of infant school is the other.

clue.text: School point-to point

parts.note: E is east, a point of the compass
N is north, a point of the compass

explanation.surface: A school with a point-to-point horse race.
explanation.walkthrough: A point-to-point is a British amateur steeplechase horse race. ETON is the famous English public school.
explanation.definitionFit: A famous English fee-paying boarding college near Windsor.

clue.text: To the French an allowance shows indulgence

parts.note: le is French for the
a ration is a fixed allowance

explanation.surface: A Frenchman's allowance reveals leniency.
explanation.definitionFit: Indulgence is forbearance, putting up with things one dislikes.
